crossRefs.note: The fear of Yahweh is the beginning of knowledge; but the foolish despise wisdom and instruction.
“How long, you simple ones, will you love simplicity? How long will mockers delight themselves in mockery, and fools…
Why is there money in the hand of a fool to buy wisdom, since he has no understanding?
Blessed is the man who doesn’t walk in the counsel of the wicked, nor stand on the path of sinners, nor sit in the seat…
but his delight is in Yahweh’s law. On his law he meditates day and night.
Behold, all the city came out to meet Jesus. When they saw him, they begged that he would depart from their borders.
Now concerning things sacrificed to idols: We know that we all have knowledge. Knowledge puffs up, but love builds up.
He took up his parable, and said, “Balaam the son of Beor says, the man whose eyes are open says;
he says, who hears the words of God, knows the knowledge of the Most High, and who sees the vision of the Almighty…
So also you, since you are zealous for spiritual gifts, seek that you may abound to the building up of the assembly.
Some indeed preach Christ even out of envy and strife, and some also out of good will.
forsaking the right way, they went astray, having followed the way of Balaam the son of Beor, who loved the wages of…

translations.web: A fool has no delight in understanding, but only in revealing his own opinion.
translations.bsb: A fool does not delight in understanding, but only in airing his opinions.
translations.kjv: A fool hath no delight in understanding, but that his heart may discover
translations.asv: A fool hath no delight in understanding, But only that his heart may reveal itself.
